executive_summary: The product team reviewed progress on the mobile app redesign, covering onboarding UI completion, auth endpoint and payment gateway integration timelines, and critical Android crash bugs found in QA. The team officially confirmed shifting the beta launch date from July 25 to August 5 to allow time for bug fixes and regression testing. Ownership was assigned for Android crash fixes and beta tester onboarding materials, with a follow-up check-in scheduled for July 20.
key_discussion_points: Onboarding UI screens are complete and pushed to the staging branch.
Auth endpoints are targeted for completion by July 22nd.
Payment gateway integration will take about two more weeks after auth, finishing around early August.
QA found 12 bugs in the latest build, including 4 critical Android 12 crashes in the payment flow.
Beta launch date was officially moved from July 25th to August 5th.

Prepare beta tester onboarding email and TestFlight/Play Store instructions

decisions_made: Beta launch date officially moved from July 25th to August 5th.
Android crash fixes prioritized above all other work before beta release.
